line.comment: * Does not check if the $outpost has enough resources. Use Mayhem.CanAfford scripts for that.
* Free stuff in the first two hours if the galaxy expansion setting has been set to "none".
* Free stuff if the AI is very weak.
* Add-Ons 1.7: Now scales with station support and population. Threshold is now a score:
* Sector = 1 point per sector. Population = 1 point per 270 pops. Station support = 1 point per 30 stations
* Calculate pop and support in percentage form first, then divide by 100 to get the points. If <= X points, all crafting is free.
